title: Kız Ararken
author: Toprak Işık
description: Across eight exuberantly comic stories, Looking for a Girl follows men and women navigating love, marriage, family and professional life in a society where everyone seems determined to manage one another’s choices. Its memorable characters include a disillusioned research assistant trapped in academic bureaucracy, a philosophy-loving young man resisting the future his father has planned for him, an engineer whose search for a wife is complicated by his mother’s expectations, and a father convinced that the midwife determines the sex of his babies. Told through intimate first-person narrators who unwittingly reveal their own vanity, jealousy and contradictions, these stories combine sharp social observation with warmth and audacious humour. Deeply rooted in Turkish life yet universal in their conflicts, the collection explores patriarchal authority, social mobility, family interference, sexual double standards and the pressure to marry without ever reducing its flawed characters to caricatures.
